title: Calculate the percentage of carbon atoms among all atoms in carcinogenic mo
question: Calculate the percentage of carbon atoms among all atoms in carcinogenic molecules that have double bonds. Also calculate the percentage of chlorine atoms among all atoms in molecules with single bonds.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
  (SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) 
   FROM atom a 
   INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010 
   INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005 
   WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND b.XCL_006 = '=') AS carbon_pct_carcinogenic_double_bond, 
  (SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'cl' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) 
   FROM atom a 
   INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010 
   INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005 
   WHERE b.XCL_006 = '-') AS chlorine_pct_single_bond

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
SELECT 
  (SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) 
   FROM atom a 
   INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010 
   INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005 
   WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND b.XCL_006 = '=') AS carbon_pct_carcinogenic_double_bond, 
  (SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'cl' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) 
   FROM atom a 
   INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010 
   INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005 
   WHERE b.XCL_006 = '-') AS chlorine_pct_single_bond

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    (SELECT 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'C' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
     FROM atom a
     JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
     JOIN bond b ON a.XCL_002 = b.XCL_005
     WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'carcinogenic' AND b.XCL_006 = 'double') AS carbon_percentage,
    (SELECT 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'Cl' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
     FROM atom a
     JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
     JOIN bond b ON a.XCL_002 = b.XCL_005
     WHERE b.XCL_006 = 'single') AS chlorine_percentage
